sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
This is second bail application.

First bail application of applicant was dismissed by following order dated 24.05.2024 :-
"Applicant has approached this Court by way of filing the present Criminal Misc. Bail Application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. in Case Crime No. 32 of 2023 under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(J), 323, 120-Kha I.P.C. and Section 4(2) of POCSO Act, Police Station- Chaubepur, District - Kanpur Nagar.
This Court has granted interim bail to applicant on 05.07.2023 with a specific condition that he will produce a marriage certificate before this Court, however,
though this application was taken up thereafter on 21.11.2023, 10.11.2023 and Rizwan Ali vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71682451/
1 30.10.2023, however, even till date,marriage certificate is not being filed on record.

entities.text: POCSO Act, Police Station- Chaubepur, District - Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Rizwan Ali vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the aforesaid circumstances, interim bail is not extended and applicant is directed to surrender within 72 hours before concerned learned Trial Court and in case of default, Trial Court is directed to take all coercive measures against the applicant.
The conduct of the applicant does not remain bonafide on interim bail, therefore, this bail application is also rejected.
Registrar (Compliance) to take steps.

"
Applicant has again approached this Court by way of filing present bail application in Case Crime No.32 of 2023 under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(J), 323, 120-Kha I.P.C. and Section 4(2) of POCSO Act, Police Station- Chaubepur, District- Kanpur Nagar.
Learned counsel for applicant refers the registration of marriage dated 21.11.2023, that present applicant has married with victim.
The present bail application is accompanied by affidavit of victim.

Learned counsel refers the statement of victim recorded during trial that she on her own will remains with applicant as husband and wife and have relationship also and now she is mother of applicant's daughter.
Learned counsel for applicant fairly submits that consent of a minor is not consent in law still in the interest of justice since they are now got married, therefore, for the benefit of a young child,
applicant may be released from jail so that young daughter can get love of her father also.
Learned A.G.A. for State has opposed the bail that offence was committed when victim was minor and she has stated before the Trial Court which indicates that crime was occurred.
I have considered the above submission and taken note that statement of victim has already been recorded and applicant is in jail since 19.02.2023 i.e. more than one year and 10 months as well as taking note of marriage certificate and that this application is accompanied with affidavit of victim,
the Court is of considered opinion that applicant has made out a case for bail to take care of his daughter.
Accordingly, bail application is allowed.
Trial Court will take all endeavour to expedite the trial.
Let the applicant- Rizwan Ali be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim/complainant in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment or exemption from appearance on the date fixed in trial.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(iii) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C., may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the Court on the date fixed in such proclamation, then, the Trial Court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law, under section 174-A I.P.C.

(iv) The Trial Court may make all possible efforts/endeavour and try to conclude the trial expeditiously, preferably within a period of six months after release of applicant,
if there is no other legal impediment.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
It is made clear that the observations made hereinabove are only for the purpose of adjudicating the present bail application.

Order Date :- 11.12.2024 P. Pandey  Rizwan Ali vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71682451/
